near_duplicate_method: Token-set Jaccard on normalized text. Pairs already counted as normalized-exact duplicates are excluded. Candidate pairs use the rare-token prefix filter for threshold 0.8, then exact Jaccard.

validation_split_vs_train_split.statement: No test assignment is stored by the trainer. The figures below compare the in-memory 10% validation indices to the other 90%. They are not a held-out test set.
